messages.subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: sample covariance can not be inverted!; lavaan WARNING: could not compute std error
parts: lavaan WARNING: sample covariance can not be inverted

Looks like a problem with the "data" you are trying to fit the model to.  Why can't sample covariance matrix be inverted?  Is it not positive definite?  (check whether the determinant is positive, or all the eigen values are positive.)  If not, it is theoretically not possible to observe such a covariance matrix, using real complete data.  Sometimes this happens when calculating covariance matrix elements using pairwise deletion...

Terry

You may have variables that are perfect linear combinations of others.
Try with one regression at a time, and add terms one at a time.
Eventually you will be able to identify the culprit.
